paper_title: Revisiting the bound on axion-photon coupling from Globular Clusters
notes: Globular cluster R-parameter bound on axion-photon coupling: g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% CL (benchmark from low-Z HII regions, Y=0.254). Limit applies in a wide mass range for axions/ALPs with mass below a few keV. Mass placeholder of 1 eV used since the bound is roughly mass-independent up to ~keV scale; the limit is a single horizontal exclusion value. Alternative bounds: 0.50e-10 (SBBN), 0.76e-10 (solar Y).
